Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.6 "Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise" Special Program
The Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.6 "Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise" Special Program will release on 2026/09/20 19:30 (UTC+8).
"The beast stirring in the darkness opens THEIR maw once more, demanding a god as a sacrifice. Before the moon rises again, only the blood of the wise can sate THEIR hunger..."

This Special Program will feature character introductions for Pearl as well as the latest information and rewards in Version 4.6.

#HonkaiStarRail #HSRSpecialProgram
